name: Your Turn To Die - Redemption Given by Fate -
source:
Three years have passed since the end of the Game of Death, the person who has survived at last might be able to live in peace and without fear of death.... But not for long.

[From [url=https://an-alternative-team.itch.io/your-turn-to-die-redemption-given-by-fate]Itch.io[/url]]

死亡游戏结束已经过去了三年，最后活下来的人或许可以安心地生活，不再惧怕死亡……但不会太久。
